## About

OMKit is a modular custom firmware for the OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II on firmware 1.1. It takes a different route from the other mods in the Atlas. The camera is flashed once with a small loader patch, and from then on the OMKit core, its modules, their updates and all their settings live in an OMKIT folder on the SD card. Adding, updating or removing a module means copying files, not reflashing.

The patch is one 5-byte hook late in startup, after the live picture is shown. It only starts a low-priority task. That task waits for the firmware's sections, skips everything if OK is held, reads OMKIT\CORE.BIN, checks its header and checksum, and jumps into it. Core then checks the firmware's fingerprint and loads the modules listed in OMKIT.INI. With no card or no file, the camera runs as stock.

The first release has two modules. CREATPRF shows the three Color and three Monochrome Profiles the firmware hides and applies them from memory. FILMLOOK replaces one picture mode with a film look whose presets are .ISP files on the card, with 32 bundled. A module SDK and three PC programs for making presets come with it. The documentation labels each finding as code, emulator, camera, inference or assumption.

### What it's working towards

- Support more cameras and firmware versions with a new driver and loader per build; core, the SDK and modules stay the same.
- Modules from other authors, written against the published SDK.

## Features

As the project describes them. Status is the project's own; linked evidence is the Atlas's record of what was reported or observed.

<div class="feature-grid" markdown="1">

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Card-loaded core and modules** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-card-loaded-core-and-modules }

A one-time loader patch starts OMKIT\CORE.BIN from the card on every power-on. Updates are file copies; no card, or OK held at power-on, gives a stock camera.

[OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · since v0.1.0 · [Evidence](../capabilities/om5-ii-omkit-loader.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Creative profiles (CREATPRF)** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-creative-profiles-creatprf }

Three colour and three monochrome profiles in the picture mode strip, edited in the camera's own column (12-sector saturation, tone curve, filter, toning, grain); applied to stills, live view and video.

[OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Film look (FILMLOOK)** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-film-look-filmlook }

One picture mode, i-Enhance by default, becomes a film look; the dials step through .ISP presets on the card, 32 bundled, with a tone curve per preset and grain on stills.

[OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · since v0.1.0 · [Evidence](../capabilities/om5-ii-omkit-filmlook.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Module SDK** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-module-sdk }

A public API table, headers and an example module HELLO for writing modules that load from the card.

[OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Preset programs** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-preset-programs }

ISP player, ISP fitter (.cube look to preset) and ISP neurofit (preset from RAW files and film scans, driven by an AI agent), run on a computer.

[OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

</div>

## Research notes

Release v0.1.0 (2026-11-20) for the OM-5 Mark II on firmware 1.1. The developers report the loader patch running on their camera since 2026-10-30 and starting core on every full power-on. Wi-Fi and USB start paths are not verified, and the project calls itself young software.
